rules: Five native pea families acquire targets against the source horizontal attack rectangle: front plant mX+60 through mX+860; Split Pea rear0 through plant mX+16. No separate center825 cutoff.
Zero horizontal overlap (edge contact) is valid. The model plant mX=cellX-40 and zombie mX=trunc(modelX-30).
Horizontal body rectangles are independent of altitude and water clipping. Mini draw scale does not scale Zombie::GetZombieRect.

Normal42px bodies, football57px, digger28px atoffset50, snorkel62px atoffset12, post-jump dolphin42px atoffset20, vehicle153px, giant125px, bottom bungee110px atoffset-20 and sliding sled leader275px atoffset-50. Walking-backward rectangles mirror in120px (giant180px).
Ordinary and snow peas use the previous integer projectile mX rectangle[-15,+40], touching edges and source integer mX collision-target ordering for these horizontal bodies.

Existing shared damage-range eligibility remains responsible for row, mind control, airborne, vault, underwater, emerging, bungee and sled follower exclusions. Other projectile families retain their existing paths.

validation.fixtureCoverage: Five families x three columns x ten body shapes x both facing directions x four attack boundaries; Split Pea front/rear, negative integer truncation, source windup offscreen, source eligibility controls, water/special/mini ordinary/snow collision.
integrationPlayerChanges: Reserve the ready Cherry Bomb budget before rebuilding under immediate pressure.
Use a selected Tangle Kelp card against the visible snorkel roster, without unnecessarily buying a Lily Pad for a native aquatic plant.
Allow emergency Cherry Bombs in all legal columns, including the rear production area.
Original seeds, model stats, victory assertions, and flag/stage requirements retained.
